entries.reason: The floor-sum certificate gives exact sign-fiber sizes (n-1+208)/4 and (n-1-208)/4. A-B and A+B must vanish on the two distinct fibers, so max(deg A,deg B) is at least (n-1+208)/4, a 254-bit degree.
entries.reopen_condition: Use a high-degree low-size circuit, modular composition, transposed evaluation, a character output chi(f), or another representation outside direct field-valued rational output.
entries.scope: An ordinary rational function A(X)/B(X), regular on every secp256k1 half-kernel root, that directly returns the field value J_G(X) in {+1,-1}.
